A working notebook of paper explainers, method walk-throughs, and the occasional opinion.
The pieces here are written for whoever finds them useful — undergraduates, collaborators
in adjacent fields, the public, and (often) future me.

If something here helps clarify a paper or a method, [drop me a line](mailto:joshuajshea@gmail.com).
